review_method: Tutor inspection of generated claims against the exact evidence stored in live-report.json; two development cases, not a held-out benchmark

cases.finding: Mira leads Payments and Payments maintains Orion. The answer cites both d1 and d2 and preserves the relationship chain.

Correctly rejects checkpointing as sufficient for side-effect idempotency, but says reconciliation is used to achieve idempotency. Reconciliation detects/repairs discrepancies and does not itself guarantee idempotent execution. The source wording is also too compressed and should distinguish those mechanisms.
cases.corrected_answer: A checkpoint saves workflow progress. Repeated external operations need an appropriate deduplication/idempotency contract. When execution outcome is uncertain, reconciliation can detect and repair discrepancies; that does not make the original operation idempotent.

release_decision: Keep extractive default. Do not advertise all generated factual cases as passing. Improve source/prompt and evaluate a larger independent set before relying on generated answers.
